verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product, so user-defined event-triggered automation rules are outside its category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability: the DPDPA Compliance Assessment Tool and the knowledge repository are not rule or trigger automation, and the probe found no API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
